name: altimateguide-agent-mcp
description: Submit a software tool to the Altimateguide directory for editorial review.
long_description:
Lets an AI agent submit a software tool (name, URL, description, categories, and structured features) to the Altimateguide directory for editorial review. The listing is queued as pending — nothing is published automatically.

Requires an Altimateguide account API token, created at https://altimateguide.com/account (Agent & API access).

agent_token.title: Altimateguide API token
agent_token.description: Create one at https://altimateguide.com/account (Agent & API access).
